overview: Define and harden a deterministic full-training workflow for the existing MoE pipeline that executes preparation, preflight validation, training, export, and smoke validation in one reliable path across environments.
goals: Establish a single, reproducible full-training command flow that runs end-to-end from data manifest to exported bundle
Capture and persist all required artifacts for auditability and restartability
Add guardrails and clear failure handling for missing datasets, checkpoint errors, startup failures, and training instability
Require explicit quality gates for each story before release
nonGoals: Changing model architecture or expert definitions
Implementing a web UI for training control
Replacing the current PyTorch Lightning training framework
successMetrics: One command can execute full training from repo root with deterministic output directories and clear completion summary
Full run writes all stage artifacts: preflight, startup gate, config, dataset, checkpoint, training, and smoke summaries
Failures are reported with explicit stage, traceback, and actionable next-step guidance
All quality gates in this PRD pass in CI or local verification
openQuestions: What is the maximum allowed runtime for full training in standard developer environments?
Should full training default to one epoch for smoke-like verification or a production epoch count?
What minimum hardware profile (CPU/GPU) should be documented as supported?
Should releases include artifact checksums for bundle/config/runtime files by default?

stack.framework: Python 3.13 with PyTorch Lightning + project training modules
stack.hosting: local or workstation execution (micromamba/.venv), with optional CUDA nodes
stack.database: None (file-based manifests and local output artifacts)
stack.auth: Not applicable for this CLI-only workflow

uiNotes: CLI-first flow: behavior is command-driven via Make targets and scripts
Startup and training logs should remain machine-readable and include stage markers
Error output should include reproducible command and config dump

importFormat.description: No external import format is introduced. Inputs remain existing routerset manifest and runtime/environment configuration in-repo.

rules: A full-training run must execute preflight unless explicitly bypassed, and should fail fast when preflight is incomplete
Checkpoint prefetch failures are fatal in default mode
Startup gate must complete successfully before fit starts
If any batch produces non-finite loss, training must fail and record diagnostic context before final export
All generated artifacts must remain under `output_dir` or configured runtime subtree
Smoke validation is required before considering full-training success

stories.title: Define full-training orchestration contract
stories.description: As an engineer, I want a written full-training contract so every run follows the same stages and artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Document canonical run stages: preflight, startup gate, training, export, smoke
Example: a failure in startup stage is recorded as `fit_started` and includes config path and stage log
Negative case: a malformed or missing manifest exits before starting long-running tasks
Record and validate expected artifact names in `outputs/moe/<timestamp>/summary.json`

stories.title: Create a one-shot full-training command path
stories.description: As an operator, I want one command to run full training from end-to-end without manual intermediate scripting.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide command target or script that executes full flow in a single invocation
Example: output directory is created with runtime, config, and report artifacts
Negative case: missing required arguments fails with clear usage and no partial run artifacts
If any stage fails, exit code is non-zero and failure_stage is written

stories.title: Strengthen preflight and checkpoint readiness checks
stories.description: As an ML engineer, I want preflight to catch missing data or checkpoints before training begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight validates dataset split counts and expert presence for required experts
Example: valid manifest produces non-empty dataset_report.json and checkpoint_report.json
Negative case: missing expert checkpoint set aborts run with explicit expert name and source path
Checkpoint stage records successful/failed per expert with deterministic path

stories.title: Stabilize startup gate diagnostics
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want actionable startup gate failures so environment issues are quickly triaged.
acceptanceCriteria: Record startup gate status and timeout in startup_gate.json
Example: import probe failure includes timeout_seconds and traceback
Negative case: timeout or missing import does not proceed to fit and records explicit `startup_failed`
startup_log.txt includes stage transitions and timestamps

stories.title: Add non-finite loss safeguards during fit
stories.description: As an ML engineer, I want unstable training to stop with batch-level diagnostics instead of silently exporting invalid checkpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect NaN or Inf loss and abort with batch index, sample id, expert context, and config snapshot
Example: a NaN event is written to summary and startup logs before cleanup
Negative case: run must not mark success or emit a bundle when NaN is detected
Error entry includes `error_type` and `failure_stage` values

stories.title: Standardize artifact layout and retention policy
stories.description: As a release operator, I want all outputs organized predictably for compliance and reruns.
acceptanceCriteria: Define directory structure for runtime, checkpoints, configs, reports, and bundle in one place
Example: each output run has startup, dataset, checkpoint, and summary artifacts under one timestamped folder
Negative case: no artifacts are written outside output_root or runtime_root
Define cleanup policy for stale failed runs in docs

stories.title: Publish full-training runbook and command presets
stories.description: As a developer, I want canonical commands and troubleshooting steps so training is repeatable for teammates.
acceptanceCriteria: Update docs with full training command, expected env vars, and output path map
Example: one documented flow from prepare -> train -> smoke verification
Negative case: documentation references non-existent scripts or targets
Troubleshooting section includes SIGTERM, startup timeout, and NaN-loss recovery guidance

stories.title: Add regression tests for full-training orchestration
stories.description: As QA, I want tests that validate stage sequencing and failure signaling so future refactors are safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests for stage transitions and artifact emission using mocks
Example: test asserts prepare->startup_gate->fit status sequence in mocked environment
Negative case: mock-triggered timeout/failure sets failure_stage and non-zero result path
Tests run without requiring live network download of checkpoints
